name: Questro - AI captions, Q&A, timer, and teleprompter for live events
tagline: Questro is a comprehensive browser-based workspace designed to streamline the technical management of live events, conferences, and town halls
description: Questro is a comprehensive browser-based workspace designed to streamline the technical management of live events, conferences, and town halls. By consolidating essential tools like speaker timers, moderated Q&A, teleprompter scripts, and AI captions into a single interface, it eliminates the need for fragmented setups. This unified approach ensures that event organizers can maintain professional standards without relying on basic tools like phone stopwatches or unmanaged microphones. Profession
